replace_layer_norm_with_fp32: recursively replace all LayerNorm modules in a PyTorch model with FP32LayerNorm equivalents
replace_silu_with_fp32: recursively replace all SiLU activation modules in a PyTorch model with FP32SiLU equivalents
set_conv2d_padding_mode: recursively set the padding mode of all Conv2d layers in a PyTorch model to a specified mode
fix_downsample2d_padding: recursively patch Downsample2D modules in a model to use a custom forward pass with replicate padding
set_group_norm_to_no_operation: recursively replace all GroupNorm modules in a PyTorch model with Identity no-op layers
